$comment: Triage policy for security scans (CodeQL, GitLeaks, Semgrep). CI should load via FINDING_POLICY_FILE and match tool + ruleIdPattern + pathPattern (and optional messagePattern) per finding.

resolvedByCodeChanges.change: Glob suffix: use replace(/\*/g, '') instead of replace('*', '') in task-execution services/utils
cleanup-branches.yml: pass github.head_ref through env MERGED_HEAD_REF and use "$MERGED_HEAD_REF" in run script
backend/Dockerfile: chown /app to user node and USER node
FrameworkConfig.set() rejects __proto__, constructor, prototype path segments

suppressions.reason: Markdown prompts and guides include example JWTs, API key placeholders, curl -H Authorization samples, and PEM fragments for illustration; they are not live credentials in the application.
API reference docs show example curl commands with placeholder Authorization headers.
Security tests intentionally include fake secrets, PEM-shaped strings, and metadata payloads to assert redaction and sanitization; not production secrets.
getCleanContent is a coarse display helper stripping angle-bracket chunks; chat UI renders via React text nodes or a sanitized markdown pipeline, not raw HTML interpolation of this string alone.

cookie-parser supports optional cookies; state-changing API routes use JWT bearer auth and CORS policy rather than cookie-based session CSRF for browser form posts. Global CSRF middleware would not match this API-first design.
If this route exists only for local or test environments, rate limiting may be intentionally omitted; confirm file is not mounted in production or gate behind NODE_ENV.
Scanner note: validate that resolved paths stay under the configured workspace root; suppress only after confirming path.resolve + prefix check (or equivalent) is present.
REST/API usage with Authorization bearer tokens; not a classic cookie-session form application requiring csurf.
Node listens on HTTP inside the process; TLS termination is expected at reverse proxy, service mesh, or platform ingress in deployment.

Handlers join paths under a project root supplied by authenticated task/CLI flows; organizational acceptance: ensure projectPath is validated and confined to allowed workspace roots at command dispatch (not arbitrary OS paths from anonymous clients).
CLI resolves paths from the invoking user’s machine; path traversal risk is local to the operator, not remote RCE by default.
Development utility connects to localhost CDP for IDE automation; not shipped as a production server surface.
Error logging uses template literals with command category/name from internal registry keys, not end-user-controlled format strings; negligible log-forging risk.

notFalsePositivesRequireReview.note: Route params used in path.join under content-library can allow traversal via ../ segments unless each resolved path is checked with path.resolve and startsWith(contentLibraryRoot). Do not policy-suppress until fixed or access is strictly authenticated and reviewed.
Same as other handler entries unless projectPath is proven trusted and bounded; re-audit if tasks can be created by low-privilege users with arbitrary projectPath.
